detail: Operator’s property guide places the Great Ceremonial House beside the monorail station and the two original pools. Used written labels to verify location names.
The operator identifies the original construction and Polynesian inspirations for the design.
The owner identifies Lava Pool’s artificial volcano, waterfall and zero-depth pool, and confirms the separate Oasis and Cove pools.
The owner documents the 10-storey Island Tower, penthouse balconies and 2024 completion.
The operator’s written account documents the resort tower’s stepped setting and overlooks toward the lagoon.
